name: Reconciliation suite — 6 scenarios vs live PO 4500000021

evaluations.name: Clean match — supplier equals the PO

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90010, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 25.00 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 5 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Both invoice lines match the PO on quantity and unit price within tolerance; no correction needed.

evaluations.name: Price variance only — item 10 priced 10% high

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90011, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 27.50 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 5 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Item 10 (RM27) is a price-variance: supplier billed 27.50 versus the PO 25.00 (+10%), outside the 2% tolerance. Item 20 matches. A correction is proposed for a human to approve; the agent reads the PO from S/4 and never posts.

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90012, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 25.00 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 6 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Item 20 (RM16) is a quantity over-delivery: 6 invoiced versus 5 ordered. Item 10 matches. The proposed correction updates OrderQuantity 5 -> 6, held for human approval; nothing is posted.

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90013, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 25.00 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 4 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Item 20 (RM16) is a quantity variance (under-delivery): 4 invoiced versus 5 ordered. Item 10 matches. A correction is prepared for human review; the agent never posts.

evaluations.name: Both variances — item 10 price + item 20 over-delivery (the demo case)

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-88231, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 27.50 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 6 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Item 10 (RM27) is a price-variance (25.00 -> 27.50, +10%) and item 20 (RM16) is a quantity over-delivery (5 -> 6). Both are flagged with a proposed correction for a human to approve before any posting; the agent reads the PO from S/4 and never posts.

inputs.supplier_document: Supplier invoice INV-90014, ref PO 4500000021, GBP. Line 1: Material RM27 (Packaging Box) 50 PC at 25.40 per ea. Line 2: Material RM16 5 PC at 2.00 per ea.

expectedOutput.summary: Item 10's 1.6% price difference (25.00 -> 25.40) is inside the 2% tolerance, and item 20 matches; the reconciliation clears with no correction needed.
